programme.title: Permanent Midnight
programme.desc: Basé sur l'autobiographie acclamée du même nom, PERMANENT MIDNIGHT met en vedette Ben Stiller et Elizabeth Hurley dans cette histoire passionnante sur un écrivain de télévision chaud qui apprend de première main le côté sombre du succès à Hollywood.

programme.title: Amour Aveugle
programme.desc: Un romancier new-yorkais est rendu aveugle par un accident de voiture qui tue sa femme. Des années plus tard, il retrouve l'envie de vivre et d'écrire lorsqu'il commence une aventure avec une femme négligée par son mari, un homme d'affaires.

programme.title: Pour l'amour de Rose
programme.desc: Rose Newell est décoratrice d'intérieur à Los Angeles. En apprenant que son père s'est cassé la jambe, elle décide d'aller épauler ses parents dans leur exploitation de tulipes, tout en gérant à distance un chantier de décoration très important pour sa carrière.

programme.title: Le Rêve de Cassie
programme.desc: Cassie, ancienne championne de rodéo, fuit son passé jusqu'au jour où elle est obligée de rentrer chez elle pour aider son père souffrant. Alors qu'elle prévoit de ne rester que quelque temps, elle change d'avis lorsqu'elle rencontre Splash, le champion de l'écurie.

programme.title: Hollywood Sunrise
programme.desc: Les acteurs d'Hollywood dissèquent leur vie personnelle lorsque tout semble s'entrechoquer.

programme.title: 2H22
programme.desc: Au cours d'une nuit enneigée, une équipe de quatre cambrioleurs expérimentés planifie un vol de routine. Lorsque les choses tournent mal, l'amitié, la loyauté et la confiance qui les lient seront poussées à leur limite.

programme.title: Coup de foudre en Toscane
programme.desc: Un jeune écrivain en herbe suit un titan littéraire souffrant du blocage des écrivains jusqu'à son refuge dans l'Italie rurale et découvre la vie et l'amour du génie irascible et de ses filles.

programme.title: Amour, Romance & Chocolat
programme.desc: Emma et le chocolatier Luc concourent pour le titre de chocolatier royal de Belgique. La beauté et le romantisme de Bruges inspirent des combinaisons de chocolat uniques, mais leur projet gagnera-t-il sans qu'ils ne perdent leur cœur ?

programme.title: Transfert
programme.desc: Ex-agent de la CIA, Tess Chandler est déterminée à comprendre ce qui est arrivé à son mari, Kelley, sérieusement blessé au cours d'une mission, désormais maintenu en vie grâce à un respirateur artificiel.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: The New Captain Scarlet - Épisode 08: Situé en 2068, Captain Scarlet suit la "guerre psychologique" entre la Terre et les Mysterons, une race martienne qui possède un contrôle partiel sur la matière. Lorsqu'un malentendu pousse des astronautes humains à attaquer leur ville sur Mars, les Mysterons jurent de se venger et lancent une série de représailles contre la Terre.

programme.title: Les Rolling Stones: Et La Fin de L'Idéalisme
programme.desc: À la fin des années 1960, l'Amérique a explosé. L'optimisme vibrant de l'été de l'amour a été brisé par des émeutes, des assassinats et une guerre sans fin. Capturant un esprit de défi juvénile, les Rolling Stones sont devenus la voix de cette nouvelle ère violente. Mais en 1969, il y a 50 ans, leur concert à Altamont a marqué la fin choquante de la décennie.

programme.title: The Ten
programme.desc: Une parodie en dix histoires courtes inspirées des dix commandements.

programme.title: Vice
programme.desc: Vice est un resort dans lequel les personnes peuvent assouvir leurs fantasmes.

programme.title: Dick
programme.desc: Alors qu'elles visitent la Maison Blanche, Betsy et Arlene, deux adolescentes, tombent par hasard sur une pièce recelant les secrets du Président Nixon. Pour découvrir ce qu'elles savent vraiment, « Richard le truqueur » les nomme promeneuses de chien officielles. Soudain les filles se retrouvent impliquées dans la fameuse intrigue politique du Watergate. Alors que le duo plonge dans l'aventure, même les hommes du Président ne pourront les empêcher de changer le cours de l'histoire.

programme.title: Martin And Lewis
programme.desc: En 1946, alors qu'il assiste à la représentation du suave jeune crooner Dean Martin, un jeune acteur, Jerry Lewis, interrompt la chanson de Dean en faisant la foire. Quand Dean reprend l'idée et commence à échanger des bons mots avec Jerry, le public aime ça, et un numéro est né.

programme.title: Le Prince de Noël
programme.desc: Quand la jeune Marie s'endort en attendant le retour de ses parents, elle entre dans le monde magique de son prince Casse-noisette, un cadeau de son oncle. Avec le groupe loufoque de noisettes et la Fée dragée, Marie aide son prince à récupérer son royaume auprès de Reginald, le Roi des souris.

programme.title: Garde Rapprochee
programme.desc: Sharp, un Texas Ranger habitué des dossiers sensibles, doit protéger les seuls témoins du meurtre de son indic : cinq pom-pom girls, incontrôlables et survoltées ! Il pensait avoir tout vu. Il va vite déchanter.

programme.title: Camping Car
programme.desc: Pour Bob Munro, sa femme Jamie et leurs deux enfants, il devient urgent de resserrer les liens, sous peine de voir leur famille exploser. Bob avait promis d'emmener tout le monde à Hawaii, mais il a brusquement décidé qu'un long périple en camping-car serait bien plus excitant... Jamie et les enfants ne passent pas vraiment les vacances qu'ils espéraient.

programme.title: Super Héros Movie
programme.desc: Un adolescent orphelin est mordu par une libellule radioactive, ce qui lui confère des pouvoirs surhumains dans cette parodie de films tels que "Spider-Man", "X-Men" et "Fantastic Four".

programme.title: Deathgasm
programme.desc: Deux geeks chevelus s'ennuient ferme dans leur bled paumé et décident de créer leur propre groupe de metal. Mais une mystérieuse partition sur laquelle ils ont mis la main va briser cette relative quiétude : quelques notes jouées suffisent à déchainer les enfers sur leur petite ville.

programme.title: Perdu a Londres
programme.desc: L'hilarant Perdu à Londres est un événement cinématographique unique en son genre qui a été filmé et projeté en direct simultanément dans certains cinémas du monde entier.

programme.title: Pris au Piège
programme.desc: À Madrid, des clients d'un bar se retrouvent piégés après qu'un homme ait été abattu en sortant. Quand un second est tué, ils comprennent qu'ils sont pris pour cible, et que personne dehors ne viendra les aider.

programme.title: Birdman
programme.desc: L'acteur Riggan Thomson, connu pour avoir incarné un super-héros, monte une pièce à Broadway autour de son propre personnage dans l'espoir de renouer avec sa gloire passée...

programme.title: L'elixir du docteur Carter
programme.desc: Un agent secret du gouvernement est envoyé pour arrêter une bande de faussaires opérant près de la frontière mexicaine.

programme.title: Les cavaliers du destin
programme.desc: Le méchant Kincaid contrôle l'approvisionnement local en eau et prévoit de se débarrasser des autres éleveurs. L'agent gouvernemental Saunders se présente sous couverture pour se débarrasser de Kincaid et gagner le cœur d'une de ses victimes, Fay Denton.

programme.title: Les Pirates du Mississipi
programme.desc: Un groupe de pirates menés par Kelly, un bandit habillé tout en noir, sème la terreur en s'en prenant aux habitants de Helena et aux bateaux postiers sur le Mississippi. Le shérif James Lively doit aller contre la méfiance des habitants mais aussi des Indiens. Mais avec l'aide des Cherokees, car les bandits se sont établis sur leurs terres, et de son adjoint Tom Quincy, il parvient à mettre fin à leurs méfaits.

programme.title: Daniel Boone
programme.desc: Daniel Boone conduit des colons dans le Kentucky, mais il doit affronter les Indiens Shawnee qui ont été persuadés par un renégat français que Boone et les colons sont là pour les tuer et leur voler leurs terres.

programme.title: Randy le Solitaire
programme.desc: Emprisonné pour des meurtres qu'il n'a pas commis, Randy s'évade et tombe sur le repaire des vrais meurtriers.

programme.title: Bandidos
programme.desc: Après que ses mains ont été mutilées par son ancien élève lors d'un vol de train, un tireur d'élite entraîne un jeune homme accusé du crime afin qu'ils puissent se venger.

programme.title: We Go On
programme.desc: Miles Grissom est prêt à offrir $30.000 à la personne qui lui prouve qu'il y a une vie après la mort.

programme.title: Mémoires Diaboliques
programme.desc: Lea, une femme napolitaine d'âge mûr vivant dans une ville du nord du pays, a eu treize enfants, tous morts à l'exception de Michele pour qui elle a une affection morbide, convaincue qu'elle l'a volé à la mort.

programme.title: Je Suis Vivant !
programme.desc: A Prague, le corps de Gregory Moore, un journaliste américain, est retrouvé dans un parc. Il est déclaré mort à la morgue, mais il est victime d'une machination. En réalité il a été plongé dans un état de catalepsie et apparaît comme décédé aux yeux de la science. Or, son esprit fonctionne encore.

programme.title: Mass Murderer
programme.desc: Eva est une jeune femme flic chargée des affaires de vols au sein de la ville de Barcelone. Un jour, elle est appelée en urgence pour rejoindre l'unité qui traque une tueuse en série ayant pour cible les vieilles femmes. Alors qu'un vent de panique s'abat sur la ville, la jeune femme pourtant novice dans ce genre d'affaires, va tenter de mettre la main sur la meurtrière… C'est sans ompter la bataille personnelle qu'elle va devoir mener de front contre son inspecteur en chef, qui passe son temps à lui fermer la porte au nez et lui compliquer la tâche au sein de l'unité.

programme.title: The Devil's Double
programme.desc: Une vision effrayante de la maison de Saddam. Le monde de Saddam prend vie à travers les yeux de l'homme qui a eu le choix : soit devenir le sosie du fils sadique de Saddam, soit mourir.

programme.title: Seule contre tous
programme.desc: Kathryn Bolkovac, une policière du Nebraska qui a servi comme gardienne de la paix dans la Bosnie d'après-guerre, dénonce l'ONU pour avoir dissimulé un scandale de trafic sexuel.

programme.title: Les révoltés
programme.desc: Dans un monde dystopique, toute personne n'étant pas blanche, chrétienne, hétérosexuelle et genrée est traquée par "Les volontaires".

programme.title: L'arnaqueuse
programme.desc: Criblée de dettes, Peg Dahl décide de se lancer dans le business du recouvrement de dettes et déclenche une guerre avec le roi des chasseurs de dettes de Buffalo…

programme.title: The Body
programme.desc: Un détective recherche le corps d'une femme fatale qui a disparu de la morgue.

programme.title: The Endless
programme.desc: Deux frères retournent dans la secte qu'ils ont fui des années auparavant pour découvrir que les croyances du groupe sont peut-être plus saines qu'ils ne le pensaient autrefois.

programme.title: Born bad
programme.desc: Quand une jeune fille rebelle mais de bonne famille tombe amoureuse d'un vagabond et lui propose de venir loger chez elle, elle ne se doute pas qu'elle a ouvert sa porte à un psychopathe...

programme.title: Elaine, portée disparue
programme.desc: Plongez dans un thriller palpitant et mystérieux. Une intrigue captivante où la disparition d'Elaine Dawson fait peser les soupçons sur le célèbre avocat Marc Reeve. Un polar intense de vérité et de mensonge.

programme.title: The Belgian Wave
programme.desc: Au début des années 90, le journaliste Marc Varenberg et son caméraman disparaissent dans des circonstances mystérieuses alors qu'ils enquêtent sur la Vague Belge (une série d'observations d'Ovni survenus entre 1989 et 1991). Près de 30 ans plus tard, deux webreporters rouvrent l'enquête pour découvrir ce qui s'est réellement passé.

programme.title: La Fille qui en savait trop
programme.desc: Jeune Américaine en vacances à Rome, Nora Davis assiste impuissante à un meurtre. Personne ne croyant son témoignage, elle se met à accumuler les indices afin de prouver sa bonne foi. Petit à petit, ce jeu de piste la met sur la voie de la prochaine victime : elle-même…

programme.title: Terrifier 2
programme.desc: Après avoir été ressuscité par une entité sinistre, Art le Clown revient dans la ville de Miles County où il prend pour cible une adolescente et son jeune frère le soir d'Halloween.

programme.title: L'Enfer des Zombies
programme.desc: Un navire venu des Antilles accoste au port de New York sans âme qui vive à bord, si ce n'est un zombie qui attaque deux gardes côtes. Avec l'aide d'un journaliste, la fille du propriétaire du bateau décide d'aller enquêter aux Antilles pour retrouver son père. Ils se rendent sur l'île de Matu et y rencontrent le docteur David Menard, qui tente d'inventer un remède contre une maladie qui ramène les morts à la vie, les changeant en zombies cannibales.

programme.title: Dominique
programme.desc: le film Dominique

programme.title: Les Dieux des Profondeurs
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une équipe de sous-marins entre dans une ouverture mystérieuse au fond de l'océan, ils découvrent un monde sous-marin perdu et réveillent un ancien peuple venu d'un autre monde.

programme.title: Le Pacte Du Mal
programme.desc: Diego, médecin endurci face à la douleur, est tenu pour responsable après la tentative de suicide de sa patiente Sara.

programme.title: Mermaid le Lac des Âmes Perdues
programme.desc: Après une étrange rencontre nocturne, Roman est frappé par une malédiction liée à son passé. Sa fiancée Marina tente de le sauver, prête à tout pour briser l'emprise surnaturelle.

programme.title: Origine Inconnue
programme.desc: Après un accident mortel sur Mars, Mackenzie Wilson collabore avec une intelligence artificielle et découvre un mystérieux objet.

programme.title: Closer to god
programme.desc: Un généticien parvient à cloner le premier être humain, une petite fille nommée Elizabeth, mais son travail est bientôt menacé par un sombre secret.

programme.title: La rivière perdue
programme.desc: Une ancienne documentariste, Erica Shaw, réalise un documentaire sur un multimillionnaire mourant, au passé mystérieux.

programme.title: Genesis
programme.desc: Dans une société post-apocalyptique, la population vit sous terre pour se protéger de la pollution. Un androïde résistant à la pollution avec IA a été développé pour aider à y parvenir

programme.title: Life Like
programme.desc: Un jeune couple acquiert un robot magnifique et réaliste pour une aide gratuite, mais à mesure que les trois se rapprochent, leur perception de l'humanité sera modifiée à jamais.

programme.title: Never Back Down 2: The Beatdown
programme.desc: L'ex-boxeur Zack, le talentueux combattant de MMA Tim, le vendeur de bandes-dessinées Justin, et le lutteur Mike viennent de différents milieux, mais ils partagent une même passion pour le combat libre et deviennent rapidement loyaux à leur entraîneur aux méthodes peu orthodoxes, Case, un brillant ex-champion d'UFC. Leur apprenant bien plus qu'à se battre, Case prépare les jeunes hommes pour une compétition appelée Beatdown, organisée par l' adolescent et imprésario Max. Lorsque leur mentor se fait avoir par quelques mauvais flics, les jeunes hommes collaborent pour découvrir le traître dans leur entourage.

programme.title: Never Back Down 3
programme.desc: L'ancien champion de MMA Case Walker garde un profil bas, en gagnant des petits combats régionaux et en refusant de participer à des ligues puissantes qui poussent leurs athlètes vers la prise de drogues pour améliorer leurs performances. Néanmoins, Walker est convaincu par un ancien ami, Brody James, de le suivre en Thaïlande et de l'entraîner pour un combat contre l'invaincu et le mortel Caesar Braga. Lorsque Brody est blessé durant l'entraînement, Case est forcé par un puissant promoteur de remplacer son ami dans ce combat épique.

programme.title: Never Back Down : La Révolte
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un combattant amateur ne veut plus se battre, sa sœur Anya (Olivia Popica) doit se rendre à Rome et participer aux combats clandestins de free fight pour aider à rembourser la dette de son frère envers le chef criminel, Julian (James Faulkner). A son arrivée, elle est emmenée de force par l'impitoyable Janek (Michael Bisping) et se rend vite compte qu'elle fait partie des nombreuses femmes qui ont été enlevées et forcées de se battre pour un syndicat de trafiquants. Les seules options qui se présentent à Anya sont céder à son tortionnaire ou de s'unir avec les autres femmes et d'abattre leurs ravisseurs.

programme.title: Ultraviolet
programme.desc: Alors qu'une guerre civile entre les humains et les vampires ravage la Terre au 21e siècle, une jeune femme doit protéger un petit garçon de neuf ans menacé de mort.

programme.title: Lost Transmissions
programme.desc: Hannah, une auteure-compositrice timide, découvre que le producteur de disques respecté Theo Ross avec lequel elle a commencé une collaboration artistique, a cessé de prendre ses médicaments contre la schizophrénie.

programme.title: Entre les jambes
programme.desc: Tout commence lors d'une réunion des sexopathes anonymes où Javier et Miranda se rencontrent. Javier, scénariste-producteur, avait un avenir brillant jusqu'au jour où il s'est livré à un jeu sexuel au téléphone qui a détruit son mariage et Miranda, animatrice d'une émission radio.

programme.title: The Last Son
programme.desc: A la fin du XIXe siècle, le bandit Isaac LeMay apprend qu'il est victime d'une prophétie annonçant sa mort de la main de son propre fils. Il décide de partir à la recherche de celui-ci, pour l'abattre avant qu'il ne le fasse.

programme.title: Wild Bill
programme.desc: Wild Bill Hickok, légendaire homme de loi et tireur d'élite, se rend dans une ville sans foi ni loi. Tout en rendant sa propre justice aux frontières, il est mis à l'épreuve par sa réputation de tireur le plus rapide de l'Ouest.

programme.title: Game Of Death
programme.desc: Un diplomate, victime d'une tentative d'assassinat, est transféré dans un hôpital. Mais ceux qui ont tenté de l'éliminer s'introduisent dans le bâtiment pour terminer la tache qui leur a été confiée… C'est sans compter sur la présence de Marcus Jones, qui a été affecté à la protection du diplomate.

programme.title: Extorsion
programme.desc: Les vacances d'une famille aux Caraïbes tournent mal. Le père de famille doit alors retrouver rapidement sa femme et son fils, qui ont été enlevés.

programme.title: Sur la défensive
programme.desc: Un ancien flic revient pour contester un complot visant à intensifier la violence des gangs dans les rues de Los Angeles.

programme.title: Wake Up
programme.desc: Un homme se réveille dans un lit d'hôpital sans se souvenir de qui il est, et apprend qu'il est recherché par la police pour avoir commis une série de meurtres.

programme.title: A Cinderella Christmas
programme.desc: Disguised as her controlling cousin, Angie goes to the Christmasquerade Ball where she falls for wealthy bachelor Nikolaus Karmichael. When he wants to marry the mysterious woman he met, she's torn between following love or letting her cousin take the credit.

programme.title: Christmas By The Book
programme.desc: Set to host a prestigious holiday gala and stuck in a love triangle, a lifestyle guru must prove she's a romance expert.

programme.title: Girlfriends Of Christmas Past

Along the way, Livvy meets Carter, and sparks fly. Can she forget about revenge long enough to let a Christmas romance blossom?

programme.desc: A fireman afraid of commitment and an aspiring veterinarian waiting for true love are drawn together by their cats, and an unexpected romance blossoms.

Despite their contrasting personalities and initial conflicts, they fall in love and face numerous challenges together, including family opposition and personal vendettas. The show blends themes of love, family, and ambition with a strong emphasis on culinary arts.

programme.title: Signs of Evil
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS, Hitler's Schutzstaffel, stands for terror and the murder of millions. The penniless graphic artist Walter Heck was given the job of designing the jagged, rune-like characters in 1929. The “sig” rune was rooted deep in the ideological cosmos of the Nazis and their supporters. They saw themselves as the descendants of the Teutons and declared the runes to be humanity's original Germanic script. The symbol was meant to unite Heinrich Himmler's “Black Order.” But did it escape their notice that it was originally of Semitic origin? In October 1945, the Allies passed a law banning the Nazi Party and all associated organizations, including the SS. The young Federal Republic even forbade all Nazi symbols. This documentary tells the gripping story of the SS symbol, from the Middle Ages to the present day.

programme.title: Destination Wild

In the South, strong westerlies bring rains that create rich green Valdivian forests, carpeting the neotropic ecozone. The Valdivian forests of Chile are a unique ecosystem harbouring species of a ‘land before time' – The forests of Valdivia represent the unique assemblage of ancient species, both floral and faunal, which today persist as relicts of Gondwanaland.

programme.title: Destination Wild

Here, in the Atacama desert, wildlife has spent millions of years adapting to a life without water. Those that survive have learnt that no opportunity comes without its fair share of risk, but for the animals of the Atacama, only those that dare, will make it in the most unforgiving desert on Earth.

The cheetah will have to learn the hunting skills their mother has perfected. Once they've learnt the ropes, they'll make their own way across the plains, establishing territory and having cubs of their own.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.desc: The first episode of this two-part nature documentary presents the natural beauty of the shifting sand dunes of the Curonian Spit, the romantic beaches of the Latvian Baltic Sea and the island worlds of Estonia. Time and again, this deserted and almost untouched nature fascinates. In the winter, ringed seals give birth to their young on the pack ice. In the spring, Konik wild horse stallions fight fierce battles amongst themselves, while colourful European rollers fly through the dune forests. Lynxes wander through the coastal forests and in the orchid meadows turncoats and hoopoes find more than enough food. On the islands around Saaremaa in Estonia, grey seals hunt for fish. They share the archipelago with Europe's largest tern, the Caspian tern.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.desc: The wide, often untouched wilderness of the Baltic hinterland is home to many animals. More than 35 brown bears live in the primeval forests of Alutaguse. In the spring, the Soomaa National Park transforms into a huge lake. Europe's widest waterfall is located in Latvia. In the beginning of May, vimba bream follow the course of the River Venta. The hardly 5-centimetre-long fish have to overcome a 4-metre-long rock barrier in order to reach their spawning grounds.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: Wild and unknown lies the still undiscovered natural paradise of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the heart of Europe. Rough mountains, dense forests and wild waterfalls characterize the picture of the untouched landscapes. Lynx, wolves and bears roam mountains and valleys. One of the last primeval forests in Europe is a retreat for many endangered animal species. Bosnia and Herzegovina is actually an undiscovered natural paradise in the middle of Europe.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: The barren, karstic south of the country, Herzegovina, also impresses with its natural landscapes. One of them is the Livno field. Not only is it the largest wetland in the country, it is also the largest regularly flooded karst field in the world. About 700 wild horses live in this unique landscape. Their ancestors were working horses that were abandoned here more than 50 years ago. Another special feature of the karst landscape are the rivers with their tufa barriers. The countless waterfalls that pour over it are a unique natural phenomenon.

programme.title: Amazing Iran
programme.desc: For the Iranian Turkmen a wedding is one of most important social events in their culture and is still celebrated according to old nomadic tradition. The Turkmen Steppe, the country of a thousand mountains, is a tribute to the hidden treasure that is Iran. Home to a proud nation with a majestic history, we show the freedom of a nomadic life, encounter the wild nature of the people and discover old traditions like the Turkmen wedding. Breathtaking sceneries create a mysticism that transports viewers into the realm of divinity while exposing a world caught between tradition and modernity - nomadism and sedentarism. Weddings in Iran are primarily arrangements between families and the product of lengthy negotiations. Even though many customs are purely symbolic, they still reflect the great significance as a rite of transition for the newlyweds and their families. The life of the Turkmen housewife revolves around weddings – first her own, later those of her children. Raising healthy, capable daughters and sons searching for possible partners mediating contact negotiating each betrothal with the family of the intended shouldering the wedding arrangements and the observance of customs and traditions – the responsibility for all of that falls to the mother. Though the Turkmen daughters and sons of today do insist on having their say, love, affection, trust and the like are still not the decisive criteria in making a match. The main consideration is not the subjective happiness of the couple but the happiness, stability and honor of each of their families as a whole. So it is still not uncommon for the bride and groom to be virtual strangers on their wedding day. The nuptials as a ritual of transition mark a series of profound changes – especially in the life of the bride. Once married, she leaves her family and her home village to take her new place within the family of the groom.

programme.title: African Voices Playmakers
programme.desc: Larry Madowo meets two trailblazing women redefining strength and resilience. Somali-born boxer Ramla Ali rose from refugee to Olympic athlete and advocate, using her platform to empower women worldwide. In Lagos, Nigerian police officer Juliet Ukah breaks barriers as the first African woman signed to the Professional Fighters League, proving that true warriors fight for more than victory.

programme.title: Inside Africa
programme.desc: Namibia's breathtaking landscapes draw travelers from around the world, but beyond its iconic desert landscapes and wildlife lies a new story of culinary and winemaking excellence. Through Wilderness Safari's pioneering hospitality and training initiatives, Neuras' award-winning wines, and the rise of visionary young chefs, Namibia is blending sustainability, culture, and innovation to redefine world-class wining and dining.

programme.title: Marketplace Africa
programme.desc: Despite poor road infrastructure, massive traffic congestion, water transportation across the abundant waterways of Lagos, Nigeria is still underutilized. Now, renewed push to develop the region's waterways has seen a growth in passenger ferrires as well as a partnership with the international boat racing franchise E1. E1 is also looking to grow their presence on the continent through digital education and outreach. We take a look at the challenges and opportunities of tapping into the region's blue economy Aspen Global CEO Samer Kassem sits down to discuss the biopharmaceutical giant's growth and why he believes it's Africa's time to shine on a global stage when it comes to business.

programme.title: Marketplace Europe
programme.desc: The World Travel Market unites industry leaders to take on the biggest challenges and trends in global tourism. From AI and sustainability, to customer service and changing traveler demands, we speak to some of the key figures in European travel to find out how our vacations will evolve in the coming years.

programme.title: U-KNOW 'I-KNOW' Spoiler Film
programme.desc: TVXQ! U-Know released a spy-style ‘I-KNOW' Spoiler Film to heighten anticipation for his upcoming comeback. Clues like word puzzles and coins, combined with the rhythm of “Body Language,” hint at the overall concept of the album.

programme.title: U-KNOW 'Body Language' MV
programme.desc: “Body Language” is a dance track blending blues, funk, and retro hip-hop, delivering a message of unity through dance. The music video artistically portrays villagers coming together through dance, with choreography by Vata of WeDemBoyz and RIEHATA of RIEHATOKYO. TVXQ! U-Know's lively vocals and performance amplify the song's upbeat and cheerful energy.TVXQ! U-Know kicks off his first full-length album ‘I-KNOW' promotions with the pre-release of the new track “Body Language.”

programme.title: U-KNOW 'Set In Stone' MV
programme.desc: The album opens with the intro track “Set In Stone,” an energetic pop song built around a powerful synthesizer riff. With its straightforward melody and strong rhythm, the track delivers Yunho's determination to “engrave the self I've preserved through doubt and confusion firmly in stone.”TVXQ's U-KNOW has completed his own musical world with his first full-length album, “I-KNOW.”

programme.title: U-KNOW 'Stretch' MV
programme.desc: Furthermore, the “Stretch” music video captures U-KNOW facing his inner shadow and engaging in a tense confrontation, portrayed through cinematic visuals and intense performance. It is also narratively connected to the previously released “Body Language” music video, adding greater depth and dimension to the world of this album.The title track “Stretch” is a pop song characterized by its powerful electronic sound, with murmured vocals that create a striking contrast and deliver a sense of tension.

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' Mood Sampler #1 | Chapter 1. How2getHearts
programme.desc: The group's vibrant visuals are paired with STELLA's captivating English narration.Hearts2Hearts' first mood sampler for their debut mini album 'FOCUS' features a rulebook concept video that shows how the members "earn hearts."

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' Mood Sampler #2 | Chapter 2. Hard2Hide
programme.desc: Hearts2Hearts' second mood sampler for their debut mini album 'FOCUS' captures the members expressing the range of emotions experienced when falling in love, such as excitement, imagination, jealousy, sadness, and obsession.

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' Trailer
programme.desc: Hearts2Hearts' first mini album FOCUS features a total of six tracks, including the title track “FOCUS,” the single “STYLE,” and the pre-release song “Pretty Please,” showcasing a diverse musical palette. In the latter part of the video, the title track “FOCUS” audio and part of the choreography are revealed, raising anticipation for the new release.The album trailer captures the members' bold and free-spirited sides as they play around and dance together in a quiet space.

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' MV
programme.desc: Its lyrics sensually express the feeling of being completely focused on someone, offering a fresh glimpse into Hearts2Hearts' unique appeal. Hearts2Hearts' first mini album title track “FOCUS” is a house genre-based song that features a vintage piano riff and an addictive melody, showcasing the group's cool and chic vocal charm. Choreographed by Jo Na-In, the performance delivers a sleek and sophisticated atmosphere.Set against a school backdrop, the music video delicately captures the complex emotions between the members.

programme.title: RIIZE 'Fame' Trailer
programme.desc: all captured through RIIZE's unique genre of “emotional pop.”RIIZE's new single “Fame” is set to be released. Focusing on the unseen side of RIIZE's growth journey, the single features a total of three tracks, including the title track “Fame.” It expresses the members' moments of anxiety, emptiness, and the intense emotions that arise amid their struggles,

programme.title: NCT DREAM : They Were Here To Beat It Up Trailer
programme.desc: The trailer “They Were Here To Beat It Up” wittily portrays NCT DREAM breaking through their limits and opening a new chapter of their own stage with surreal visuals and storytelling, powerfully setting the tone for the beginning of the new album. NCT DREAM's 6th mini album “Beat It Up” consists of six tracks, including the title track of the same name, “Beat It Up.” Centering on the theme of “the speed of time,” the album delivers a bold message that the members — who have been running toward their dreams since childhood — continue to grow, while confidently moving forward at their own pace and in their own way.

programme.title: NCT DREAM 'Beat It Up' MV
programme.desc: The title track “Beat It Up” hits hard with bold kicks, heavy bass, and a vibe that's all about breaking limits with confidence. NCT DREAM's sixth mini album “Beat It Up” takes on the theme of 'the speed of time', sending a message that they're moving forward in their own pace and style. The music video amps it up even more with a boxer concept, powerful moves, snappy cuts, and punch-heavy choreography that fires off the song's energy.

programme.title: Best and Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester's crabby neighbour, Grumpy Pants, asks them to babysit his cactus plant, Pricklebutt. Later, they want to knock off work early to catch the season finale of their favourite TV show.

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: The Might And The Magic
programme.desc: Aaron races across the kingdom to gather the NEXO-Knights as Jestro and his Destructive Monsters attack the King's Castle. The Knights must get back to the capitol in time, or Jestro will rule the kingdom! Jestro, while still attacking the King's Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he's found (and has been saving.) It's the powerful “Book of Revenge!” Now, combining the powers of Revenge and Destruction, Jestro and his monsters will get their vengeance on King Halbert and the Kingdom of Knighton. Jestro and his monsters lay siege…will they destroy the castle?! Meanwhile, Aaron races across the Kingdom gathering the NEXO-Knights one at a time. As each Knight rejoins the group, they become a more and more powerful team. They even get Robin to join them as the Black Knight in his repaired power suit. Our Knights arrive, finally regrouped, fight off Jestro, save the castle and the King. It's a glorious victory! The King is so pleased after seeing how the brave NEXO-Knights saved his kingdom, he allows Macy to join them as an official NEXO-Knight.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

programme.desc: The search for the Sandman leads Mateo and the others to the tallest mountain in the Dream World, but Lunia's hourglass puts a target on their backs.

programme.title: The Anomaly
programme.desc: A surprise visit from the Chief Inspector of the Night Bureau forces Mateo to hide Z-Blob, who goes on an adventure in the heart of Brooklyn.

programme.title: The Digiverse And Beyond, The Elemental Masters
programme.desc: Tackling a puzzle about technology in Ninjago. A riddle requires the Ninja to consider the powers and history of the Elemental Masters.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: The Whole Smurf And Nothing But The Smurf
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel is able to capture the Smurfette. Now he is going to give her a truth serum and know all of Papa Smurf' secrets… But then Gargamel makes a big mistake and gives the Smurfette a fib formula!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Baby's Marvelous Toy: It's been a few hundred years since Grandpa Smurf has seen this old toy… It was given to Papa Smurf long, long ago and he does not remember what it does. But Baby Smurf does know that it brings surprises for everyone!

programme.title: He Who Smurfs Last
programme.desc: Jokey's practical jokes go too far when Chlorhydris is the victim of one. She gets her revenge on the Smurfs by creating a spell to steal their sense of humor. Grouchy, who had no sense of humor to begin with, breaks the spell by getting back the humor potion.

programme.title: Jokey's Medecine
programme.desc: Because of Jokey's pranks, none of the Smurfs believe him when he tells them that Azrael the cat is ready to pounce on them. Feeling guilty and responsible, he hurries to Gargamel's castle and plays some explosive jokes on the wizard and his cat so he can free his friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Royal Drum: No one believes Grandpa Smurf when he tells of far-away jungles and savannahs teeming with wild giant cats, striped horses, long-necked leaf-eaters and strange tribes... Only some Smurflings give some credit to his tales. But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Kow-Tow, We Won't Bow: Smurfette leads the Smurflings on a nature hike, but Puppy gets too far ahead and they chase him into the land of the Wartmongers. King Bullrush captures them in bubbles and imprisons them. A group of rebels rescue the Smurflings and they escape on the back of Puppy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf On The Wild Side, Part I: What, or who, is that strange being in the forest? It looks vaguely like a Smurf, but it chatters away like the squirrel that seems to be accompanying it… And why is Papa Smurf talking about the Lost Smurfling?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Snappy's Puppet: Snappy has a new trick: he frightens everybody, or tries to, with his hand-puppet dragon. But it gets, shall we say, out of hand when Papa Smurf's magic liquid falls on the puppet and it comes alive. Alive and kicking, what's more, endangering Snappy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - No Smurf Is An Island: Handy Smurf is the one who fixes everything that needs mending in the Village of the Smurfs. But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Crooner Smurf: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Baby Smurf Is Missing: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Smurfing Out Of Time: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. They go on a visit to Father Time and come across the River of Time, the great current that flows along majestically, carrying with it all the time in the world. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Memory Melon: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf For Denisa: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Peewit's Unscrupulous Adventure: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Poltersmurf: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs

Marvin tries different avenues to help eliminate these difficulties, but his efforts are futile. Now, he decides to take desperate measures in saving his family and finances. When hell breaks loose and nothing seems to work, a true character is revealed through Marvin. Later on, Marvin discovers martial arts through his best friend Frank Biggs. This martial art will help Marvin find himself again and give him a sense of purpose. As he continues to search deeper his new found art, his troubles aren't stagnant. Marvin still has to wake up and face the demons of his life. Marvin has got to get his life out of this never diminishing cage and find freedom. In the meantime, Claire Fields (Marvin's wife) is fed up and tired of supporting the family. Marvin's cage seems invisible to Claire, and this continues to trigger his frustration. In the end, true love and friendship will be revealed and seem to help break down the barriers around this mysterious cage.

programme.title: Sound Trekd Ep.1
programme.desc: Korea's first gugak band formed by foreign residents <Sound Trek> embarks on its very first journey. From every corner of the world, foreign souls gathered in Korea, united by the timeless sound of gugak. Dreams trebble like the strings of a gayaguem. Before the masters of gugak they compete. Who will be the next five to begin the legend of Sound Trek?

programme.title: Sound Trekd Ep.2
programme.desc: Finally, the five members of Sound Trek have been selected! From accordion, flute, and Morin Khuur to djembe, and even a Mexican sorikkun (Korean traditional singer), they are now ready to write a new page of gugak. Their mentor, Kwon Songhee, former lead vocalist of the band Leenalchi, believes their potential, supporting every step of their way.

programme.title: Sound Trekd Ep.3
programme.desc: Gugak still feels unfamiliar to the members. But they never gave up. Then one day, a gugak expert joins them for an arrangement collab. Sound Trek decides to reinterpret the famous minyo(folk song), “Sarangga” in their own unique style.

programme.title: Sound Trekd Ep.4
programme.desc: With one-on-one coaching from their mentors and countless hours of repeated practice, their skills have now reached new heights. Then, an exciting piece of news arrives — Sound Trek has been invited to perform at the Uzbekistan National celebration, the homeland of Alex!

programme.title: Sound Trekd Ep.5
programme.desc: SoundTrek arrived in Uzbekistan with butterflies in their stomachs and successfully completed their performance to the crowd's applause. They proved that music knows no boundaries, and that even non-Koreans can perform gugak if they have enough passion. Their journey, however, is far from over.

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Har Har Bhakti

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Do Chutki Sindoor
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: Janani
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Fury Spinner Ep 06 Part A
programme.desc: After decades of development, Fury Spinner duel has become one of the most popular sports in the world. At this time, the "Ultimate Feast" Invitational Tournament of Fury Spinner began. The protagonist Meteo is invited to the mysterious island together with other top players in the world to embark on a survival adventure. During the adventure, Meteo not only relied on his determination to protect the weak and gained recognition to unlock the power of the sacred beast, but also got acquainted with the hidden master Kim who came here to find his brother and Joll who wanted to prove as the “perfect warrior” to his father. However, this "Ultimate Feast" tournament is just a conspiracy of the organizer Kenji! He wants to use the players to awaken the evil forces in the island to destroy the world! Meteo and friends stepped forward and tried their best to defeat Kenji.

programme.title: Sanrachna
programme.desc: Shelter - one of mankind's most basic physiological needs. At least that's what it started out as at the beginning of time. From dwelling in caves to carving out temples in mountains, mankind has redefined shelter with every passing era. Though the underlying philosophy of any monument is to serve some sort of function, great architecture is fuelled by imagination. India's architecture is built on that very imagination and is a fascinating fusion of both art and science. From strategically placed astronomy towers to impressive and awe-inspiring tombs, Indian architecture has pushed the limits of engineering and design. Sanrachna explores these architectural wonders and how the makers of these marvels made them without the aid of modern mechanics and machinery. With an immensely astute sense of engineering, the architects were able to construct fortresses that have stood the test of time, unshaken by its changes. Join our host Vaibhavi as she travels through the country discovering the fascinating stories behind India's outstanding monuments and its architecture. Sanrachna will leave you in awe of the past and its ability to do what we can't, even with our modern tools and fancy tricks.
